blocks.text: Reigning queen Emma Mary Tiglao has encouraged the candidates of Miss Grand International 2026 to be “competitive yet kind” as they gear up for the final leg of the competition. In a message posted on Instagram ahead of the coronation night on Saturday, Oct. 10, in Bangkok, Thailand, Tiglao shared lessons from her own pageant journey. “To my MGI 2026 sisters,” she began. “If there’s one thing I’ve learned from my own journey, it’s that a pageant is never just about the crown.” Tiglao acknowledged that competing in an international pageant can bring both excitement and pressure. “There will be moments […]...
